larcal.m: I don't have time for you, kid. Get lost.
r: I found a note with your name on it while looking for the book 'Calomyran Secrets'.

larcal_1.m: Now now, what have we here? Are you implying that I have been down in Arcir's basement?

larcal_2.m: So, maybe I was. The book is mine anyway.

larcal_3.m: Look, let's solve this peacefully. You walk away and forget about that book, and you might still live.
r: No, you will give me that book.

larcal_5.m: OK, now you're starting to annoy me, kid. Get lost while you still can.
r: No, that book is not yours!

larcal_6.m: You are still here? OK then, if you want the book that bad, you will have to take it from me!
r: At last, a fight. I have been waiting for this!
I had hoped it wouldn't come to this.

calomyran.10: An old man standing outside in Fallhaven has lost his book 'Calomyran Secrets'. I should go look for it. Maybe in Arcir's house to the south?
calomyran.20: I found a torn page of a book called 'Calomyran Secrets' with the name 'Larcal' written on it.
calomyran.100: I gave the book back to the old man.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
